title: total_cmp NaN panic latency
method: Rust probe with catch_unwind feeding overflow-engineered finite inputs
notes: candidate_heights.sort_by(|a,b| a.total_cmp(b)) confirmed at src/ecg/peaks.rs:225. Behavioral: 9 adversarial finite-input cases (amplitude 1e150..1e300, alternating +/-1e160 spikes, raw NaN/inf samples) - zero panics under catch_unwind. Amplitude >=1e155 overflows squaring to +inf and is caught by the filter-stage output guard (src/signal/filter.rs:505-506,541-542) -> clean Err(NonFiniteInput), not silent NaN. Amplitude 1e150 (squared 1e300, still finite) legitimately returns 29 peaks. Remaining P3 nit: message 'Input signal contains non-finite values' is emitted even when the raw input is finite and only intermediates overflowed.
